::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 9th [1887]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection[^1]
:::

Dear [Sir](people/person_2370.qmd)

The lines are certainly not mine - nor do I think I could ever have quoted them for I do not remember ever to have heard them[^2]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Envelope addressed to J B [or R?] Scarlett Esq/ 24 Cramer Terrace/ Gateshead on Tyne, postmarked 87.
[^2]: CMY's correspondent, an accountant who is listed at this address in the 1891 census, used the same trick to get autographs from both Thomas Hardy and A. C. Swinburne:  see *Collected Letters of Thomas Hardy*, VII, 105 and *The Swinburne Letters*, V, 231.
